Direction A — Handmade Warmth
Refines the current palette: warm cream ground, serif headings (Fraunces), rounded photo cards with soft shadows. Closest to today's site — lowest translation effort, safest evolution.

Direction B — Playful Scrapbook
Butter-cream ground, chunky rounded 'Baloo 2' display font, polaroid-style tilted hero photo, washi-tape accents. Leans hardest into 'handmade for kids' — most distinctive, most novel to build.

Direction C — Bold Storybook
Deep maroon + cream, editorial Playfair Display serif, asymmetric split hero, minimal-border product cards. Most premium/boutique feel — trades candy-bright cheer for craft-forward elegance.
